source_verification.method: Exact SHA-256 comparison of every .py, .js, .css and .html file under pcs in the verified release ZIP against the actual served app-source/pcs copy. Compiled bytecode and runtime data are excluded.

homepage_refresh.notes: The normal PCS host, storage APIs, authentication and interface were used. The supported trusted_hosts argument admits only the isolated preview host in addition to loopback. No model was started, no provider key was supplied and no microphone, OBS or personal vault was used.
